note: Bob's model shop. Each entry says what it is for, how big it is, how much graphics memory it wants, and its licence. Every model has 'files', downloaded straight from a pinned link into models\bob and checked against its sha256. An 'ollama' name as well means: pulled through Ollama instead when Ollama is Bob's engine (no second copy). Links marked verify:true still need checking on the PC before the Download button is shown.

categories.label: Talking and planning
categories.what: Bob's everyday brain: chat, notice board, reminders, research.

categories.label: Coding
categories.what: The workbench: writing and fixing code.

categories.label: Bob's voice

models.name: Gemma 4 26B
models.what: Bob's main brain. Fast, sees pictures, good with tools.

models.name: Gemma 4 E4B
models.what: Small and quick. Good for laptops and 8 GB cards. Can also hear audio.

models.name: Qwen3 4B Instruct 2507
models.what: Tiny and quick. Bob's Gaming brain (on the processor), and the Brain on 4 to 6 GB cards.
models.phoneFit: Second choice on an 8 GB phone; a bit slower than Gemma 4 E2B.

models.name: Qwen3.6 27B
models.what: A careful, strong thinker for Deep thinking and reviews. All 27B of it works at once, so a little sits in RAM on a 16 GB card and replies are slower.

models.name: Qwen 3.8 27B
models.what: Bob's slow but smart thinker. Strong at hard problems; about 10 words a second on a 16 GB card because a little of it sits in RAM.

models.name: Qwen3.5 9B
models.what: A small all-rounder for 8 GB cards: chats, codes a little, sees pictures and keeps a long chat in mind.

models.name: Qwen3.5 4B
models.what: A tiny brain that also sees pictures. Fits 4 to 6 GB cards.

models.name: Qwen3.5 2B
models.what: The smallest brain here. Quick on a phone or an old laptop, and it sees pictures; keep the questions simple.
models.phoneFit: Fits an 8 GB phone easily; the lightest choice.

models.name: Gemma 4 E2B
models.what: Gemma 4's smallest brain. The phone app's brain, and a light Quick brain on a PC; it sees pictures.
models.phoneFit: The phone app's pick for an 8 GB phone (about 11 words a second on a Galaxy S22, from others' tests).

models.name: Qwen3 Coder 30B
models.what: The workbench brain. Strong coder with a long memory (128K).

models.name: gpt-oss 20B
models.what: The second-look reviewer. Very fast, careful thinker.

models.name: Qwen2.5 Coder 7B
models.what: Small coder for laptops and offline backup.

models.name: Qwen3.6 35B-A3B
models.what: A newer coder and all-rounder: sees pictures, thinks before it answers, and keeps up to 256K in mind. Only 3B of it works at a time, so it stays quick even with part of it in RAM.
models.raced: Beat Qwen3 Coder 30B on a 16 GB card (2026-11-03). At 256K (2026-11-04) it uses 15.0 GB on the card with the rest in RAM, writes about 49 tok/s, and found a fact hidden 201K tokens in.

models.name: Qwen3.6 35B-A3B (8 GB card version)
models.what: My Coding brain squeezed into a smaller file for cards of 8 GB or less. It's a little less sharp than the full one, and most of it sits in your RAM, so replies come slower. On a bigger card I use the full version instead.

models.name: Qwen2.5 VL 7B
models.what: Reads screenshots and documents. Older: Gemma 4 and Qwen3.5 already see pictures, so it's optional.

models.name: Whisper base (English)
models.what: Small, quick speech-to-text. Runs on the processor.

models.name: Whisper large v3 turbo
models.what: Very accurate speech-to-text, still quick. Any language.

models.name: Z-Image Turbo
models.what: Fast, sharp pictures in 8 steps. Good with text in images.

models.name: Z-Image Turbo (quick-load version)
models.what: The same fast picture model in a smaller file: about half the download (11 GB). It loads faster and leaves room on a 16 GB card for the Quick brain.

models.name: Z-Image Turbo (8 GB card version)
models.what: The same fast picture model, squeezed to fit an 8 GB card. Pictures look almost the same as the full one.

models.name: Z-Image Turbo (6 GB card version)
models.what: The fast picture model made small enough for 6 GB cards and laptops. A touch less detail than the bigger versions.

models.name: FLUX.1 schnell
models.what: Quick, good-looking pictures in 4 steps. Big download.

models.name: Qwen Image Edit 2509
models.what: Picture edits from references: keeps a character or scene's look in new poses and places. Takes up to 3 reference pictures.

models.name: FLUX.2 klein 4B (picture edits)
models.what: Small, quick picture editor: change a picture with words, or keep a character's look from reference pictures. Fits an 8 GB card.

models.name: FLUX.2 klein 4B (picture edits, 6 GB card version)
models.what: The small picture editor made even smaller for 6 GB cards and laptops.

models.name: LTX-2.3 22B
models.what: Higher quality clips with sound, from words or a picture. Big and slow on a 16 GB card.
models.license: LTX-2 Community License (free under $10M yearly revenue)

models.name: Wan 2.2 TI2V 5B
models.what: Short clips from words or a picture. Lighter and quicker than LTX.

models.name: Wan 2.2 TI2V 5B (small card version)
models.what: Short clips from words or a picture, squeezed for 8 GB cards. Slow, so keep clips to a few seconds.

models.name: Ryan (US English, high quality)
models.what: A calm, clear American man's voice. Bob's default.
models.license: MIT (Piper); voice data licence on its model card

models.name: Alan (British English)
models.what: A dry, low-key British man's voice. Very Bob.
models.license: MIT (Piper); voice data licence on its model card

models.name: Lessac (US English, high quality)
models.what: A bright, expressive American voice.
models.license: MIT (Piper); voice data licence on its model card

models.name: Kokoro voice pack (22 English voices)
models.what: Natural-sounding voices that run on the processor: Michael, George, Lewis, Heart, Emma and more. Pick the voice in Settings after it's in. Bob's pick for his own voice.

models.name: Nomic Embed Text
models.what: Tiny helper that lets Topics and search find related things by meaning. Runs on the processor.

models.name: ACE-Step 1.5 music models
models.what: What the music engine needs to compose: the song model, its sound decoder, its text reader and its planning brain. Downloaded once, then music works offline. Needs the audio tools first.

packs.label: 16 GB card or more

notes.gemma4-e4b: the quick brain, and it sees pictures and hears you
notes.qwen3.6-35b-a3b: everyday chat and coding in one load: a big context (256K, how much it keeps in mind). It answers Low-effort chat straight off and always thinks coding jobs through

packs.times: Pictures take about 10 seconds each, clips a few minutes.

packs.label: 8 GB card

notes.gemma4-e4b: one model for chat, quick brain, eyes and ears, so everyday chat never swaps
notes.qwen3-coder-30b: the best coder; most of it sits in your RAM, so replies are slower (roughly 15 to 25 words a second)
notes.z-image-turbo-q5: a version of the painter made to fit your card
notes.flux2-klein-4b: a small, quick editor: change a picture with words or keep a look from references
notes.wan2.2-ti2v-5b-q4: slow on this card: keep clips to a few seconds

packs.times: Rough guesses, not yet measured on an 8 GB card: about 30 seconds to a minute a picture, a minute or two an edit, 10 minutes or more a short clip. Bob puts his brain away while he paints, so chat waits until the picture is done.

packs.label: 6 GB card (most laptops)

notes.qwen3-4b: the everyday brain: small and quick, and leaves room on the card for longer chats
notes.gemma4-e4b: sees pictures and hears you; it loads only for those jobs
notes.qwen2.5-coder-7b: small, quick coder that fits the card
notes.z-image-turbo-q4: a version of the painter made to fit 6 GB cards
notes.flux2-klein-4b-q4: a small editor made to fit 6 GB cards
notes.wan2.2-ti2v-5b-q4: very slow on a 6 GB card, so it is left unticked; tick it if you want short clips anyway

packs.times: Rough guesses, not yet measured on a 6 GB card: about 1 to 2 minutes a picture or an edit; clips take a long time. Bob puts his brain away while he paints.

packs.label: Built-in graphics (handhelds and thin laptops)

notes.qwen3-4b: the everyday brain: small and quick on built-in graphics
notes.gemma4-e4b: sees pictures and hears you; it loads only for those jobs
notes.z-image-turbo-q4: the small painter: a picture takes a few minutes on built-in graphics
notes.flux2-klein-4b-q4: a small editor: change a picture with words, or keep a look from references
notes.wan2.2-ti2v-5b-q4: clips are very slow on built-in graphics, so it is left unticked; tick it if you want short clips anyway

packs.times: Rough guesses, not yet measured on built-in graphics: a few minutes a picture or an edit, and a long wait for a short clip. Bob puts his brain away while he paints, so chat waits until the picture is done. Turning on Match picture settings to my graphics card (Settings, Show advanced settings, Engines & speed) makes pictures 768 px, which is quicker.

packs.label: No graphics card (processor only)

notes.gemma4-e4b: chats, plans, researches, sees pictures and hears you, all on the processor

packs.times: Without a graphics card Bob can talk, plan, research, read pictures and speak, but not paint or film.

packs.label: Raspberry Pi or ARM board, 8 GB or more

notes.gemma4-e2b: chats, plans and sees pictures, all on the processor; keep the jobs small

packs.blurb: A small set that lets Bob chat, plan, research, see pictures and hear you on the board's processor.
packs.times: On a Raspberry Pi 5 a reply starts in a few seconds and comes at a few words a second. There's no painting or filming on an ARM board.

packs.label: Raspberry Pi or ARM board, 4 GB

notes.qwen3.5-2b: the lightest brain: chats and sees pictures on the processor; keep the questions simple

packs.blurb: The lightest set: Bob chats, plans and sees pictures on the board's processor, with room left for the system.
packs.times: On a Raspberry Pi 5 a reply comes at a few words a second. There's no painting or filming on an ARM board.
